author: rcmacf
text:
FXformula,

I'm afraid those are not QMs from my point of view. Take another look at the QM article, and read this thread.

Also, before going to find more QMs, maybe consider what they are. They are an effort by somebody to take the weaker players out of the market, so they can more easily move price in the direction they choose. A QM is used to fake out people in both directions. So, the extreme of the QM should look like it faked something, ideally.

I've marked 2 QMs on your chart.
